detail.longDescription: Homelab check in. Proxmox on an old laptop with every service in its own LXC, split across VLANs so nothing can talk to anything it has no reason to. DNS runs through Pi-hole and Unbound. Wazuh and Suricata watch the traffic, OpenVAS runs scans, and Uptime Kuma tells me when something falls over. Everything leaves the network through a Mullvad gateway and I reach it all remotely over Tailscale. SearXNG is the newest piece and it's already the default search on my devices. I'm always in the middle of rebuilding something and the list keeps growing. What's the next service worth adding? I'm curious what you'd run if you were starting over. # homelab # selfhosted # selfhosting # proxmox # infosec
